sign_in.subtitle: Signing you in…
sign_in.working: Taking you to the sign-in screen.
sign_in.error_title: We could not start the sign-in
sign_in.error_subtitle: Nothing was handed over, so it is safe to try again.

no_access.title: Not a support agent
no_access.subtitle: This account is signed in, but it does not answer tickets.
no_access.subtitle_email: {{email}} is signed in, but it does not answer tickets.
no_access.alert_body: An administrator has to grant the support:agent permission. Sign in again afterwards so a fresh token carries it.

ticket.note_hint: Only the support team sees this. It sends nothing.
ticket.reply_hint: Goes to everybody on the ticket. If nobody comes back within 30 minutes, they get an email.
ticket.summary_hint: Written by the model that read the incoming email. Not shown to the requester.
ticket.delete_confirm: Delete this ticket and its whole conversation? This cannot be undone.

assist.title: Draft an answer
assist.hint: Searches the help centre and drafts a reply from what it finds. Read it before you send it — it is a draft, not an answer.
assist.insufficient: Nothing in the help centre covers that. Worth writing an article once you have answered.

labels.title: Labels

labels.delete_confirm: Delete this label? It comes off every ticket carrying it.

articles.title: Help articles
articles.delete_confirm: Delete this article? It comes out of both search indexes.
articles.reindex_hint: For repairing drift after an outage or a model change.
